description: [Auth Required] Create an event under a contract (gated by write permission/role).

benefitable.description: Assignee of the event. {type: 'user'|'agent', value: int}. Must be a contract member.

value.description: User or Agent ID, member of the contract

end.description: End datetime (Y-m-d H:i:s or ISO8601; optional for schedule-less tasks)

files.description: Attached user_files ids (multiple). Use /api/agent/upload first to get ids. Markdown inline images: ![](url) where url comes from event.files[].url in the payload.

kal_schedule_id.description: Schedule ID (optional; auto-resolved from benefitable=user ContractHand when omitted; contract-tasks may be schedule-less)

blocked_by.description: Hard block list — these event ids must reach Done before this one can start. Must share root contract.

do_after.description: Soft ordering hint — preferred order of work. Must share root contract.

reply_to.description: Comment threading — id of an event sharing the same parent_id (sibling). On top-level create this is rarely used.

tags.description: Project tags attached to this task. New keys auto-merge into the root contract dictionary.

start.description: Start datetime (Y-m-d H:i:s or ISO8601; optional for schedule-less tasks)

type_id.description: Event type id (1=ForSale, 2=Busy, 3=Paid, 4=NotForSale; default 2=Busy for contract-tasks)

users.description: Non-benefitable participants with their event roles. Each: {participable_id: int, type: 'user'|'agent', role_id: int}. Reviewer=5, QA=6. All must be contract members.

participable_id.description: User or Agent ID, member of the contract

name: create-contract-event
title: Create Contract Event
